title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭~Seismic connections for precast concrete
focus: 以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位~Emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre
summary: 從預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑與自復位原理出發，計算混合預力梁柱接頭的開口、鋼腱應力與軟鋼脫黏長度，設計灌漿套筒續接，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定、樓梯與樓板的支承長度與滑動縫、ACI 374.1 試驗允收與 PRESSS 縮尺試驗，最後談套筒灌漿缺陷檢測與震後預力復驗，並以 The Paramount、PRESSS 試驗建築與基督城地震的公開教訓對照。~Starting from the seismic load path of precast frames and the principle of self-centring, compute gap opening, tendon stress and mild-steel debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned beam–column joints and design grouted sleeve splices, then handle temporary stability during erection, seating length and sliding joints for stairs and floors, ACI 374.1 test acceptance and the PRESSS scaled test, and finally detection of sleeve grouting defects and post-earthquake prestress checks, compared with public lessons from The Paramount, the PRESSS test building and the Christchurch earthquake.

units.title: 預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑~Seismic load path in precast structures
units.mechanism: 現澆混凝土建築的連續性是自然形成的，預鑄建築則必須由接頭刻意建立：樓板慣性力經板間接合器、弦材與集力構件傳到抗側力牆或構架，再經柱底或牆底接頭進入基礎。任何一段接頭不足，整條路徑就斷開。設計上有兩種策略：等同現澆（emulative）讓接頭比構件更強，把塑性鉸推離接頭；接合式（jointed）則讓變形集中在接頭本身，以預力與耗能元件控制行為。1994 年 Northridge 地震中預鑄停車結構的倒塌，正是傳力路徑在接頭處中斷的典型。~Continuity in cast-in-place concrete arises naturally, whereas in precast buildings it must be created deliberately by connections: floor inertia forces travel through panel-to-panel connectors, chords and collectors to lateral walls or frames, then through column-base or wall-base joints into the foundation. If any connection is inadequate, the path is broken. Design follows one of two strategies: emulative, making connections stronger than members so plastic hinges move away from the joints, or jointed, concentrating deformation in the joints themselves and controlling it with prestress and dissipating elements. Collapses of precast parking structures in the 1994 Northridge earthquake typify a load path broken at the connections.
units.model: 某樓層重量 W = 8,000 kN、隔板設計加速度 0.3 g，樓板慣性力 F = 0.3×8,000 = 2,400 kN，由兩道剪力牆各承受 1,200 kN；每道牆沿線設 12 個板—牆接合器，平均每個 100 kN，若隔板依規範要求以 2.0 倍超強設計，每個接合器需約 200 kN。數值為教學假設。~A floor weighing W = 8,000 kN with a diaphragm design acceleration of 0.3 g develops an inertia force F = 0.3×8,000 = 2,400 kN, shared by two shear walls at 1,200 kN each; with 12 slab-to-wall connectors along each wall, the average is 100 kN per connector, and with a diaphragm overstrength of 2.0 each needs about 200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 繪製每一樓層的傳力路徑圖，標示每個接合器、弦材與集力構件的需求與容量，確認從樓板到基礎沒有任何一段僅靠摩擦或未設計的接觸傳力；審查時逐一核對接頭型式與設計策略（等同現澆或接合式）是否一致。~Draw a load-path diagram for every floor showing demand and capacity of each connector, chord and collector, confirming that no link from slab to foundation relies on friction or undesigned contact; at review, check that each connection type matches its design strategy, emulative or jointed.
units.failure: 隔板接合器或集力構件不足時，地震中樓板與牆分離，樓板失去側向支撐，柱承受未設計的大變形而破壞；若只依重力荷載設計擱置支承，板件在大變位下從支承滑落。~With inadequate diaphragm connectors or collectors, floors separate from walls in an earthquake, columns lose lateral support and fail under undesigned deformation; bearings designed for gravity alone let units slide off at large displacement.
units.misconception: 預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。~If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads.
units.practice: 設計說明應明列整棟建築採用的耐震策略與每種接頭的類別，並要求預鑄廠的接頭細部圖由結構技師核可；未經核可不得以其他接頭替代。~The design basis should state the seismic strategy for the building and the category of every connection type, with the precaster's connection details approved by the structural engineer; no substitution without approval.

units.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯~Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems
units.mechanism: 接合式預鑄構架把梁與柱以無黏結預力鋼腱夾在一起，地震時梁端與柱面之間張開一個縫，構件本身幾乎不受損；預力在震後把縫重新壓合，使結構回到原位，這就是自復位。只有預力時遲滯迴圈幾乎沒有面積，耗能不足，因此再加入會降伏的軟鋼筋或耗能元件，得到形如旗子的遲滯迴圈：既能耗能，又能在卸載後歸零。關鍵在於預力提供的回復彎矩必須大於軟鋼的降伏彎矩，否則殘留變位無法消除。~A jointed precast frame clamps beams to columns with unbonded post-tensioning tendons; in an earthquake a gap opens between beam end and column face while the members themselves stay nearly undamaged, and after shaking the prestress closes the gap and returns the structure to its original position, which is self-centring. Prestress alone gives hysteresis loops with almost no area and too little dissipation, so yielding mild-steel bars or dissipating devices are added to produce a flag-shaped loop that both dissipates energy and returns to zero on unloading. The key is that the restoring moment from prestress must exceed the yield moment of the mild steel, otherwise residual drift cannot be removed.
units.model: 預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。比值 λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1，卸載後預力足以把軟鋼拉回，殘留變位小。數值為教學假設。~With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m; mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa gives T_s = 525 kN at a 0.55 m lever arm, M_s ≈ 289 kN·m. The ratio λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1, so on unloading the prestress can pull the mild steel back and residual drift stays small. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以接頭的彎矩—轉角分析或試驗確認旗形迴圈的形狀、卸載後殘留轉角與每循環耗能；設計報告中列出每個接頭的 M_pt、M_s 與 λ，確認在材料強度上下限下都大於 1。~Confirm the flag shape, residual rotation after unloading and energy per cycle by moment–rotation analysis or testing of the joint; list M_pt, M_s and λ for every joint in the design report and confirm λ exceeds 1 for both upper- and lower-bound material strengths.
units.failure: 若為增加耗能而放入過多軟鋼，λ 小於 1，震後縫無法閉合，結構留下明顯殘留傾斜，修復困難；預力損失過大也會降低 λ，使原本自復位的系統逐年失去復位能力。~Adding too much mild steel for dissipation drops λ below 1, so gaps cannot close after the earthquake and the structure is left with visible residual lean that is hard to repair; excessive prestress loss also lowers λ, so a self-centring system gradually loses its recentring ability over the years.
units.misconception: 接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。~More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy.
units.practice: 設計者應同時設定耗能與復位兩個目標，並在圖說中標明預力值、軟鋼面積與允許偏差；任何現場變更預力束數或鋼筋量，都須重新計算 λ 並經核可。~Designers should set both dissipation and recentring targets and show prestress, mild-steel area and tolerances on drawings; any site change in strand count or bar area requires recalculating λ and approval.

units.anchor: 混合接頭脫黏軟鋼~Debonded mild steel in hybrid joint
units.title: 混合預力梁柱接頭的開口與脫黏長度~Gap opening and debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned joints
units.mechanism: 混合接頭（hybrid connection）由穿過柱的無黏結預力鋼腱與梁上下緣灌漿套管內的軟鋼筋組成。層間變位幾乎全部轉為梁端開口轉角，開口在鋼腱處造成伸長，因鋼腱無黏結，伸長分攤到整段長度，應力增加有限、保持彈性；軟鋼筋則在接頭附近刻意脫黏一段長度，讓伸長分散在這段長度內，控制應變以避免低週疲勞斷裂。The Paramount 等預鑄混合構架建築即採用此類接頭概念。~A hybrid connection combines unbonded post-tensioning tendons through the column with mild-steel bars grouted in ducts at the top and bottom of the beam. Almost all storey drift becomes gap-opening rotation at the beam end, which elongates the tendon; being unbonded, the tendon spreads the elongation over its full length, so stress rises modestly and stays elastic, while the mild bars are deliberately debonded over a short length near the joint so their elongation is spread over that length, limiting strain and avoiding low-cycle fatigue fracture. Precast hybrid-frame buildings such as The Paramount use this connection concept.
units.model: 梁深 700 mm、層間變位 2%：梁端最外緣開口 0.02×700 = 14 mm，位於梁中央的鋼腱伸長 0.02×350 = 7 mm；跨越兩個接頭、長 16 m 的鋼腱應變增加 14/16,000 = 0.0875%，應力增 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa，由 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa 增為約 1,194 MPa，仍低於降伏。軟鋼距轉動點 600 mm，伸長 12 mm，若限制應變 3%，脫黏長度需 12/0.03 = 400 mm。數值為教學假設。~For a 700 mm beam at 2% drift, the extreme gap is 0.02×700 = 14 mm and a mid-depth tendon elongates 0.02×350 = 7 mm per joint; over a 16 m tendon crossing two joints the strain rises by 14/16,000 = 0.0875%, adding 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa, from 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa to about 1,194 MPa, still below yield. Mild steel 600 mm from the rotation point elongates 12 mm, so a 3% strain limit needs a debonded length of 12/0.03 = 400 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 檢查設計最大變位（例如 3.5%）下鋼腱應力是否仍在彈性範圍、軟鋼應變是否在試驗驗證的範圍；施工時確認脫黏套管長度與位置、灌漿套管密實、預力千斤頂壓力與伸長量紀錄，並與計算值比較。~Check that tendon stress stays elastic and mild-steel strain stays within the tested range at the maximum design drift, for example 3.5%; during construction confirm debonding sleeve length and position, duct grouting and jack pressure and elongation records against calculations.
units.failure: 若脫黏長度在現場被灌漿填滿或過短，軟鋼應變集中在數公分內，在幾個大循環後斷裂，接頭失去耗能；鋼腱若因錨碇處腐蝕或灌漿誤入而變成部分黏結，大變位時局部降伏，預力永久損失，自復位能力下降。~If the debonded length is filled with grout on site or made too short, mild-steel strain concentrates over a few centimetres and the bar fractures after a few large cycles, losing dissipation; tendons made partly bonded by anchorage corrosion or stray grout yield locally at large drift, permanently losing prestress and recentring ability.
units.misconception: 混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。~Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
units.practice: 圖說要以明顯符號標示「無黏結鋼腱」與「軟鋼脫黏段」，灌漿作業前由監造確認脫黏套管封堵完整，並設為停止點；錨碇與鋼腱的防蝕細節須可檢查。~Drawings should mark ‘unbonded tendon’ and ‘mild-steel debonded zone’ prominently, and before grouting the site supervisor must confirm that debonding sleeves are sealed, as a hold point; anchorage and tendon corrosion protection must be inspectable.

units.anchor: 灌漿套筒續接器~Grouted sleeve splice
units.title: 柱底灌漿套筒續接與等同現澆接頭~Grouted sleeve splices at column bases and emulative joints
units.mechanism: 等同現澆的預鑄柱常以灌漿套筒把柱主筋與基礎或下層柱的鋼筋續接：下方鋼筋插入預埋在柱底的鋼套筒，再以高強無收縮灌漿填滿，鋼筋力經灌漿黏結與套筒內的凸肋傳遞。柱底正是塑性鉸區，續接器必須能發展鋼筋的抗拉強度而不先破壞，才能讓塑性變形留在鋼筋上。接頭的弱點在施工：插筋錯位、套筒灌漿不滿或灌漿強度不足，外觀完全看不出來。~Emulative precast columns often splice their main bars to foundation or lower-column bars with grouted sleeves: the lower bars enter steel sleeves cast into the column base, which are then filled with high-strength non-shrink grout, and bar force transfers through grout bond and ribs inside the sleeve. The column base is exactly the plastic-hinge zone, so the splice must develop the bar's tensile strength without failing first, keeping plastic deformation in the bars. The weakness lies in construction: misaligned dowels, partly filled sleeves or weak grout are completely invisible from outside.
units.model: 鋼筋 D32（A_b = 804 mm²）、抗拉強度 f_u = 620 MPa，灌漿黏結應力 τ = 12 MPa：所需埋入長度 L = A_b·f_u/(π·d_b·τ) = 804×620/(π×32×12) ≈ 413 mm；若套筒每側提供 16 d_b = 512 mm，餘裕約 24%。數值為教學假設。~For a D32 bar (A_b = 804 mm²) with tensile strength f_u = 620 MPa and grout bond stress τ = 12 MPa, the required embedment is L = A_b·f_u/(π·d_b·τ) = 804×620/(π×32×12) ≈ 413 mm; a sleeve giving 16 d_b = 512 mm per side leaves a margin of about 24%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 續接器型式須有試驗報告證明能發展鋼筋規定抗拉強度，並在工地以同批材料做灌漿立方試體與續接器拉力抽驗；安裝前量測插筋位置與突出長度，灌漿時確認出漿口溢流，並記錄每支套筒。~The splice system needs test reports showing it develops the bar's specified tensile strength, with site cube tests of the same grout batch and sample tension tests of splices; measure dowel positions and projection before setting, confirm grout flows from every outlet during grouting and log each sleeve.
units.failure: 插筋偏位時工人可能彎折鋼筋強行插入，或把套筒周邊鑿開，使鋼筋在套筒內偏心；灌漿未從出漿口溢出就停止，套筒上半段空洞，地震時鋼筋在套筒內拔出，柱底在達到設計彎矩前破壞。~Misaligned dowels tempt crews to bend bars into place or break out concrete around the sleeve, leaving bars eccentric inside it; stopping grout before it flows from the outlet leaves voids in the upper sleeve, so in an earthquake bars pull out and the column base fails before reaching its design moment.
units.misconception: 灌漿套筒只要灌了漿就一定合格，不需要逐支檢查。~A grouted sleeve is acceptable as soon as grout goes in, with no need to check each one.
units.practice: 柱吊裝就位前以樣板確認插筋位置，偏差超過允許值須由設計者決定處置，嚴禁現場熱彎；灌漿作業由受訓人員執行，逐支記錄出漿確認與灌漿批號，並設為柱上方構件安裝前的停止點。~Check dowel positions with a template before setting each column; deviations beyond tolerance go to the designer, and hot bending on site is forbidden; grouting is done by trained operatives, with outlet flow and grout batch logged for every sleeve as a hold point before members above are erected.

units.anchor: 吊裝臨時斜撐~Erection temporary bracing
units.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定~Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete
units.mechanism: 預鑄構件在接頭灌漿、焊接或預力完成之前，只是彼此擱置的獨立構件，抗側力與穩定都依賴臨時斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓。施工階段的風、吊車碰撞或小地震，都可能在此時造成連續傾倒。因此吊裝計畫必須定義每一階段的穩定系統：哪些構件先完成永久接頭、臨時斜撐何時可以拆除、上方可以吊裝多少層而不超過下方未灌漿接頭的能力。~Before connections are grouted, welded or post-tensioned, precast members are independent pieces resting on each other, relying on temporary braces, shims and erection bolts for lateral resistance and stability. Wind, crane impact or a small earthquake during this phase can trigger progressive toppling. The erection plan must therefore define the stability system at every stage: which members receive permanent connections first, when temporary braces may be removed, and how many levels may be erected above ungrouted joints without exceeding their capacity.
units.model: 預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m；斜撐接於 3.0 m 高處，水平分力 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN，斜撐與地面 60°，軸力 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN，兩支各 6.4 kN，乘 1.6 後各約 10.2 kN。數值為教學假設。~A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m; braces attached at 3.0 m height need a horizontal component of 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN, and at 60° to the ground the axial force is 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN, 6.4 kN in each of two braces, or about 10.2 kN each with a 1.6 factor. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊裝計畫附臨時穩定計算、斜撐與地錨的容量、拆除條件與停止風速；每日開工前檢查斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓，接頭灌漿強度達到規定值（以試體證明）後才拆除臨時斜撐，並記錄日期與拆除人員。~The erection plan includes temporary stability calculations, capacities of braces and ground anchors, removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; braces, shims and erection bolts are inspected before work each day, and braces are removed only after joint grout reaches the specified strength, proven by cubes, with dates and personnel recorded.
units.failure: 為了加快進度而在接頭灌漿強度未達前拆除斜撐，強風時牆板或柱傾倒並撞倒相鄰構件；墊塊材料或位置錯誤使構件偏心擱置，灌漿後殘留應力，日後在接頭處開裂。~Removing braces before joint grout gains strength to save time lets panels or columns topple in strong wind and knock down neighbours; wrong shim material or position leaves members eccentrically seated, locking in stresses that later crack the joint.
units.misconception: 預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。~Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing.
units.practice: 吊裝計畫須由具資格的工程師簽認，列明每一階段的穩定系統、斜撐拆除條件與停工風速；這是工程檢核的停止點，不是吊掛作業的操作許可。~The erection plan must be signed by a qualified engineer, stating the stability system at every stage, brace-removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; it is an engineering hold point, not an operating permit for rigging.

units.anchor: 樓梯滑動支承長度~Stair sliding-seat length
units.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容~Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility
units.mechanism: 預鑄樓梯與樓板擱置在梁或牛腿上，地震時上下樓層產生相對位移，若樓梯兩端都被固定，它會像斜撐一樣受壓而破壞；若一端設計為滑動，滑動量與支承長度必須足以容納最大層間變位，並保留施工誤差與邊緣剝落的餘裕。2011 年基督城地震中，Forsyth Barr 大樓與 Grand Chancellor 飯店的預鑄樓梯崩落，就是滑動縫與支承長度不足以容納層間變位的教訓，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會報告對建築非主結構構件的變位相容提出檢討。~Precast stairs and floor units sit on beams or corbels; in an earthquake the floors above and below move relative to each other, and a stair fixed at both ends acts like a brace and fails in compression. If one end is designed to slide, the sliding allowance and seating length must accommodate the maximum storey drift plus margins for construction tolerance and edge spalling. In the 2011 Christchurch earthquake, precast stairs collapsed in the Forsyth Barr building and the Hotel Grand Chancellor, a lesson in sliding joints and seats too small for storey drift, and the Canterbury Earthquakes Royal Commission reviewed the deformation compatibility of elements outside the primary structure.
units.model: 樓高 3.5 m、最大層間變位 2.5%，相對位移 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm。滑動端支承長度 ≥ 87.5 + 施工誤差 20 + 邊緣剝落 20 + 最小承壓 50 ≈ 178 mm，另一側間隙也須 ≥ 87.5 mm，否則樓梯受壓頂住。數值為教學假設。~With a 3.5 m storey and 2.5% maximum drift, the relative displacement is 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm. The sliding-end seat must be at least 87.5 + 20 construction tolerance + 20 edge spalling + 50 minimum bearing ≈ 178 mm, and the gap on the other side at least 87.5 mm, or the stair jams in compression. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求；安裝後實測每支樓梯的支承長度與兩側間隙並拍照，確認間隙未被砂漿、裝修材或防火填縫硬性材料填滿。~Obtain each storey's maximum drift, including torsion, from analysis and convert it into sliding demand for every stair and floor unit; after installation measure and photograph each stair's seating length and gaps on both sides, confirming they are not filled with mortar, finishes or rigid firestopping.
units.failure: 間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。~Gaps packed with mortar or finishes turn the stair into a brace that fails in compression or pushes off its seat; seats sized only for gravity let stairs slide off corbels at large drift, cutting off the escape route.
units.misconception: 預鑄樓梯兩端都固定比較牢靠，地震時比較安全。~Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake.
units.practice: 圖說應標示每支樓梯的固定端與滑動端、最小支承長度與間隙，並規定間隙只能以可壓縮材料填充；裝修與防火填縫施工前須確認不影響滑動。~Drawings should show the fixed and sliding end of every stair, minimum seating length and gap, and require gaps to be filled only with compressible material; fit-out and firestopping must be checked not to impede sliding.

units.anchor: 反覆載重試驗允收~Cyclic test acceptance
units.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比~ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio
units.mechanism: 接合式預鑄構架的行為不能完全以現澆規範推論，因此 ACI 374.1 以結構試驗作為允收依據：以實尺度或大尺度梁柱子結構承受逐級增大的反覆位移，至少到 3.5% 層間變位，並檢查強度保持、相對能量消散比與卸載後的勁度。ACI 550.3 則針對以無黏結預力形成的預鑄特殊抗彎構架，規定在符合這些試驗允收的前提下的設計方法。試驗的價值是同時證明強度、韌性與耗能，而不是只看最大承載力。~The behaviour of jointed precast frames cannot be inferred entirely from cast-in-place rules, so ACI 374.1 makes structural testing the basis for acceptance: full- or large-scale beam–column subassemblies are cycled at increasing displacements up to at least 3.5% drift, and strength retention, relative energy-dissipation ratio and stiffness around zero are checked. ACI 550.3 then gives design methods for precast special moment frames with unbonded post-tensioning that satisfy these acceptance criteria. The value of testing is that it proves strength, ductility and dissipation together rather than peak capacity alone.
units.model: 相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。在 3.5% 變位的第三循環，迴圈面積 26 kJ；以 ±400 kN 尖峰力與扣除彈性段後各 0.09 m 的位移形成的平行四邊形面積 (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ，β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18，高於 1/8 = 0.125 的允收下限。數值為教學假設。~Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par. In the third cycle at 3.5% drift the loop area is 26 kJ; the parallelogram formed by ±400 kN peaks and 0.09 m of post-elastic displacement each way has area (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ, so β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18, above the acceptance minimum of 1/8 = 0.125. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。~When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs.
units.failure: 若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度；只看最大力而忽略第三循環的強度衰減，會高估韌性。~Applying results from a specimen that is too small or simplified to real joints ignores differences in cover spalling, grouting and anchorage, so real joints may lose strength at smaller drifts; looking only at peak force and ignoring third-cycle strength decay overstates ductility.
units.misconception: 只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。~A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength.
units.practice: 採用新型預鑄接頭前，須確認已有符合 ACI 374.1 的試驗或安排專案試驗，試驗計畫與報告由設計者與審查者核可；試驗涵蓋範圍外的尺寸變更不得逕行套用。~Before adopting a new precast joint, confirm that ACI 374.1-compliant tests exist or arrange project tests, with test plan and report approved by designer and reviewer; size changes beyond the tested range must not be applied without justification.

units.anchor: PRESSS 五層試驗建築~PRESSS five-storey test building
units.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律~Large system tests and scaling similitude
units.mechanism: 接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。1999 年在加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成的 PRESSS 五層預鑄試驗建築，以約 60% 縮尺在同一棟試驗建築的兩個方向分別放入多種預鑄構架與接合式剪力牆系統，以擬動態方式施加逐級增大的地震，驗證了混合構架與接合式牆的自復位與低損傷表現，後續影響了 ACI 規範與 The Paramount 等建築。縮尺試驗必須了解相似律，才能把試驗力量換回實尺度。~Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building. The PRESSS five-storey precast test building, completed at the University of California, San Diego in 1999 at about 60% scale, placed several precast frame types in one direction and a jointed shear-wall system in the other, applied earthquakes of increasing intensity pseudodynamically, and demonstrated the self-centring, low-damage behaviour of hybrid frames and jointed walls, later influencing ACI provisions and buildings such as The Paramount. Scaled tests require an understanding of similitude to convert test forces back to full scale.
units.model: 以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。實尺度梁端彎矩 420 kN·m 在試體中只有約 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m，實尺度預力 1,200 kN 對應約 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN；層間變位比則與實尺度相同。數值為教學假設。~For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216. A full-scale beam-end moment of 420 kN·m becomes about 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m in the specimen and a full-scale prestress of 1,200 kN about 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN, while drift ratios are the same as at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。~Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions.
units.failure: 若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。~If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis.
units.misconception: 縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。~Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone.
units.practice: 引用系統試驗作為設計依據時，在計算書中說明縮尺、相似律換算與適用範圍；實際工程的樓板與梁接合方式應與試驗一致，否則須評估開口行為對樓板的影響。~When citing a system test as design basis, explain the scale, similitude conversion and range of applicability in the calculations; the project's floor-to-beam connection should match the test, or the effect of gap opening on the floor must be assessed.

units.anchor: 套筒灌漿非破壞檢測~Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout
units.title: 隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷~Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects
units.mechanism: 預鑄接頭最難管理的是隱蔽在混凝土內的部分：灌漿套筒、預力套管、預埋鋼板與焊接接合器，一旦封閉就無法目視。檢測必須在施工中留下紀錄，並在完工後以非破壞方法抽查，例如超音波、X 光或衝擊回音法檢測套筒灌漿飽滿度，內視鏡檢查預力套管，鋼筋掃描確認預埋件位置。使用期間則以防水、防蝕與定期檢查維持外露接合器與預埋鋼板的狀態。~The hardest part of precast connections to manage is what lies hidden inside concrete: grouted sleeves, post-tensioning ducts, embedded plates and welded connectors cannot be seen once closed. Inspection must leave records during construction and be followed by non-destructive sampling after completion, for example ultrasonic, X-ray or impact-echo checks of sleeve grout fill, borescopes in post-tensioning ducts and cover scanning to locate embeds. In service, waterproofing, corrosion protection and periodic inspection maintain exposed connectors and embedded plates.
units.model: 套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。數值為教學假設。~With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依抽樣計畫對灌漿套筒做非破壞檢測（例如每層一定比例，發現缺陷即擴大抽樣），可疑者以鑽孔內視或補灌確認；檢測結果與施工灌漿紀錄對照，並把缺陷位置與處置寫入竣工資料。~Apply non-destructive testing to grouted sleeves according to a sampling plan, for example a set proportion per floor with expanded sampling when defects appear, confirming suspect sleeves by drilled borescope inspection or regrouting; compare results with grouting logs and record defect locations and treatment in the as-built records.
units.failure: 若只依賴施工人員的口頭確認而沒有紀錄與抽查，灌漿缺陷可能大量存在而無人知曉，直到地震時多根柱同時在柱底拔出；外露的焊接接合器在停車場等潮濕環境中鏽蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降。~Relying on verbal assurances without records or sampling can leave widespread grouting defects unknown until an earthquake pulls out many column bases at once; exposed welded connectors in damp environments such as car parks corrode, losing section and diaphragm capacity.
units.misconception: 接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。~Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.
units.practice: 施工規範應規定隱蔽接頭的紀錄格式、非破壞檢測的抽樣比例與擴大抽樣條件，並由獨立檢驗單位執行；外露接合器須有防蝕塗裝與定期檢查週期。~The specification should set record formats for hidden connections, NDT sampling rates and triggers for expanded sampling, carried out by an independent inspection body; exposed connectors need protective coatings and periodic inspection intervals.

units.anchor: 預力浮升檢驗~Prestress lift-off check
units.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接~Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover
units.mechanism: 接合式預鑄建築的優點是震後損傷少、可快速復原，但必須證明預力仍在、縫已閉合、樓梯與樓板支承未移位。震後檢查要量測殘留層間變位、梁端殘留開口、軟鋼脫黏段附近的混凝土狀態，並以千斤頂浮升試驗確認鋼腱預力；等同現澆的接頭則檢查柱底與梁端塑性鉸區裂縫與剝落。交接文件需記錄每種接頭的位置、型式、預力值與檢測紀錄，讓未來的評估有依據。~The advantage of jointed precast buildings is little damage and quick recovery after an earthquake, but engineers must prove that prestress remains, gaps have closed and stair and floor seats have not shifted. Post-earthquake inspection measures residual drift and residual gap at beam ends, examines concrete near the debonded mild-steel zones and confirms tendon force by jack lift-off tests; emulative joints are checked for cracking and spalling in column-base and beam-end hinge zones. Handover records must document every connection's location, type, prestress and inspection results to support future assessments.
units.model: 浮升試驗以千斤頂活塞面積 0.030 m² 量測：設計預力 1,200 kN 對應 40 MPa 油壓；若錨碇在 34 MPa 時浮升，實際預力約 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN，損失約 15%，λ 由 1.45 降到約 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23，仍大於 1，但應評估是否重新施拉。數值為教學假設。~A lift-off test uses a jack with 0.030 m² piston area: the design prestress of 1,200 kN corresponds to 40 MPa; if the anchorage lifts off at 34 MPa, the actual force is about 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN, a loss of about 15%, so λ falls from 1.45 to about 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23, still above 1 but warranting assessment for restressing. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較；預力損失或殘留變位超過允許值時，由結構技師評估重新施拉、更換軟鋼或其他修復。~After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines; where prestress loss or residual drift exceeds limits, the structural engineer assesses restressing, mild-steel replacement or other repairs.
units.failure: 若完工時沒有記錄預力基準與錨碇可檢查的設計，震後無法確認預力是否損失，只能保守地長期停用；樓梯支承在地震中移位卻未被檢查，下一次地震或日常使用中才突然崩落。~Without completion baselines for prestress and inspectable anchorages, nobody can confirm after an earthquake whether prestress was lost, forcing long conservative closures; stair seats displaced in an earthquake but never checked may collapse suddenly in the next event or in daily use.
units.misconception: 預力是永久的，震後不需要再確認。~Prestress is permanent and needs no checking after an earthquake.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含接頭型式與位置圖、預力施拉與浮升基準、灌漿與非破壞檢測紀錄、樓梯滑動端與間隙紀錄、震後檢查表，並規定錨碇保護蓋可拆除檢查；任何改裝影響接頭或樓梯間隙前須經結構技師核可。~Handover should include connection type and location plans, stressing and lift-off baselines, grouting and NDT records, stair sliding-end and gap records and the post-earthquake checklist, and require removable anchorage caps for inspection; any alteration affecting connections or stair gaps needs prior structural engineer approval.

example: 設計練習：某預鑄混合抗彎構架梁深 700 mm，梁端以無黏結鋼腱施加 P = 1,200 kN（初始 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa），力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；上下緣軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²，以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa、力臂 0.55 m 計，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m，復位比 λ ≈ 1.45。設計層間變位 2% 時梁端開口 14 mm，16 m 長鋼腱應力增約 171 MPa 至約 1,194 MPa；軟鋼伸長 12 mm，以 3% 應變上限需脫黏 400 mm。柱底 D32 灌漿套筒以 τ = 12 MPa 計需埋入約 413 mm，提供 512 mm。若最大考量地震變位達 3.5%，開口增為約 24.5 mm，鋼腱應力約 1,322 MPa 仍低於降伏，但軟鋼伸長 21 mm，脫黏長度須增至約 700 mm；若震後浮升試驗發現預力損失 15%，λ 降為約 1.23。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: a precast hybrid moment frame has 700 mm beams post-tensioned with unbonded tendons at P = 1,200 kN (initially 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa) at a 0.35 m lever arm, so M_pt = 420 kN·m; top and bottom mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa and a 0.55 m lever arm gives M_s ≈ 289 kN·m and a recentring ratio λ ≈ 1.45. At 2% design drift the beam-end gap is 14 mm and a 16 m tendon gains about 171 MPa to about 1,194 MPa; the mild steel elongates 12 mm, needing 400 mm of debonding for a 3% strain limit. D32 grouted sleeves at the column base need about 413 mm of embedment at τ = 12 MPa, and 512 mm is provided. If the maximum considered drift reaches 3.5%, the gap grows to about 24.5 mm and tendon stress to about 1,322 MPa, still below yield, but the mild steel elongates 21 mm and needs about 700 mm of debonding; if a post-earthquake lift-off test finds 15% prestress loss, λ drops to about 1.23. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: 1994 年 Northridge 地震中多座預鑄停車結構倒塌，凸顯預鑄接頭與隔板傳力的弱點。美日合作的 PRESSS 研究計畫在 1990 年代發展接合式預鑄系統，1999 年於加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成約 60% 縮尺的五層預鑄試驗建築，驗證混合構架與接合式剪力牆的自復位行為；舊金山 The Paramount 公寓以預鑄預力構架在約 2001 至 2002 年完工，完工時被稱為該地震分區最高的混凝土構架建築。2011 年基督城地震中預鑄樓梯崩落，促使各國重新檢討預鑄構件的變位相容。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Several precast parking structures collapsed in the 1994 Northridge earthquake, exposing weaknesses in precast connections and diaphragm load paths. The US–Japan PRESSS research programme developed jointed precast systems in the 1990s and in 1999 completed a five-storey precast test building at about 60% scale at the University of California, San Diego, demonstrating self-centring of hybrid frames and jointed shear walls; The Paramount apartment tower in San Francisco, built with precast prestressed frames, was completed around 2001 to 2002 and was then described as the tallest concrete-framed structure in its seismic zone. Precast stair collapses in the 2011 Christchurch earthquake prompted renewed review of deformation compatibility for precast elements. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: The Paramount 公寓高約 128 m（420 ft）、約 40 層，由 Englekirk 結構顧問設計、Pankow 營造~The Paramount apartment tower is about 128 m (420 ft) tall with about 40 floors, engineered by Englekirk and built by Pankow
The Paramount 約在 2001 至 2002 年完工，完工時被稱為該地震分區最高的混凝土構架建築~The Paramount was completed around 2001 to 2002 and was then described as the tallest concrete-framed structure in its seismic zone
PRESSS 五層預鑄試驗建築於 1999 年在加州大學聖地牙哥分校以約 60% 縮尺完成試驗~The PRESSS five-storey precast test building was tested at about 60% scale at the University of California, San Diego in 1999
ACI 374.1 要求反覆試驗至少達 3.5% 層間變位，且相對能量消散比不低於 1/8~ACI 374.1 requires cyclic tests to at least 3.5% drift with a relative energy-dissipation ratio of at least 1/8
2011 年基督城地震中 Forsyth Barr 大樓與 Grand Chancellor 飯店的預鑄樓梯崩落~Precast stairs collapsed in the Forsyth Barr building and Hotel Grand Chancellor in the 2011 Christchurch earthquake

紐西蘭皇家調查委員會於 2012 年 8 月公布第一部分報告，第 2 冊檢討基督城市中心建築表現~The Canterbury Earthquakes Royal Commission released Part One of its report in August 2012, with Volume 2 reviewing central Christchurch building performance
PCI 設計手冊目前為第 9 版，是預鑄預力混凝土設計與製造的主要參考~The PCI Design Handbook, now in its 9th edition, is the main reference for precast prestressed concrete design and manufacture

PRESSS 五層預鑄試驗建築在加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成試驗~The PRESSS five-storey precast test building is tested at the University of California, San Diego

紐西蘭皇家調查委員會發布報告，檢討建築與非主結構構件的地震表現~The Canterbury Earthquakes Royal Commission reports on building and secondary-element performance
